description: The South Atlantic Environmental Research Institute (SAERI), based in the Falkland Islands, hosts WebGIS portals it has helped build for UK overseas territories. The project list read on 2026-09-28 includes a baseline webmap for Montserrat produced for the Government of Montserrat under a Darwin-funded data management project, from which data can be downloaded; a habitat map and a land-use model for Saint Helena; coastal habitat mapping, marine spatial planning, natural capital assessment, soil mapping, heritage sites and a renewable energy web project for the Falkland Islands; marine spatial planning tools for Turks and Caicos; and a map of protected areas across the South Atlantic territories from 2016. Coverage is these small island territories. Access is free in the browser, and each project has a metadata sheet; licences are set per project and not stated on the list. Caveats: most projects are environmental, infrastructure appears mainly in the baseline maps and the renewable energy project, and several date from project cycles several years ago. It supports reference layers for hazard exposure and energy planning on remote islands. Related record: the Saint Helena census housing tables complement the island layers.
